messages:
maya: Heads-up — found a goroutine leak in the Go SDK generator streaming sample when auth refresh + ctx cancel happen together. repro attached in the thread.

maya: Steps: call `client.Generator().Stream(ctx, ...)`, then cancel outer request ctx while an in-flight auth refresh (token refresh goroutine) fires. goroutines pile up.

maya: Minimal repro (paste):
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
it := client.Generator().Stream(ctx, req)
go func() {
    time.Sleep(100 * time.Millisecond)
    cancel() // simulate client cancel while auth refresh is racing
}()
for it.Next() { /* drain */ }
// observed: runtime.NumGoroutine() increases and never goes down
```

jon: thanks. do you know whether the leak is in retry logic or in the iterator's wait loop? any stack dumps?

maya: stack shows a goroutine blocked in `auth.Transport.roundTrip` waiting on token chan, and another blocked in `iterator.next` that never sees the closed underlying stream. looks like cancellation isn't propagated into the auth retry helper when the iterator is mid-block.

sam: i can repro locally. reproduced with `go1.20`, linux. quick grep shows auth refresh uses a background goroutine that selects on a token chan and a `done` chan, but `done` isn't wired to ctx.Done() in some code paths.

sam: possible fixes:
- wire ctx through the auth refresh so it cancels ongoing refreshes
- make iterator `Next(ctx)` instead of `Next()` so callers can unblock operations immediately

lena: i prefer adding a context param to the iterator methods for ergonomics: `Next(ctx context.Context) bool` and `Close(ctx context.Context) error` so we avoid adding global cancel channels. we can keep backwards compat by adding new methods and deprecating old ones.

jon: adding ctx avoids race of which ctx to cancel (outer vs internal). but it's a breaking behavior pattern for many users — we should avoid forcing a major bump.

maya: proposal: add `NextWithContext(ctx)` (non-breaking) that short-circuits blocking waits, keep `Next()` as wrapper calling `NextWithContext(context.Background())` with deprecated note. update sample app to show `NextWithContext(ctx)` usage.

sam: i sketched a tiny patch that wires ctx to auth retry and adds `NextWithContext` — small test added: `TestGeneratorStreamCancelRace`. locally green. will open PR.

devex-bot: flagged: needs-review @devex @eng-runtime

ci-bot: CI failed on PR branch with flaky in `generator_stream_cancel_test.go:43` (timeout). re-ran.

sam: re-ran tests, added an explicit ctx cancel in test to assert cleanup. tests pass on linux/amd64.

lena: thanks. please include changelog note about new `NextWithContext` and mark `Next()` deprecated for removal in 2 releases. update go-sdk README example.

jon: also file an internal issue to audit other places where auth refresh spins goroutines without ctx wiring (embeddings client had similar pattern).

maya: i'll update the sample app in `examples/generator` and add a short blurb in the migration guide.

sam: opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/pull/427 (WIP). @lena can you review once CI is green?

lena: will review tomorrow morning. thanks for the quick repro + patch work. :thumbsup:

maya: nice teamwork. follow-up: schedule 15m sync if review blocks land.
